Open visits this item's source conversation. The server label distinguishes identical names on different networks. A closed query can be reopened locally; a missing channel is not silently joined. Reading help leaves the source unread.

Query opens a private conversation without sending. Whois asks the server for public nickname information. Ignore changes local filtering. Back returns to the conversation. Up/Down chooses an action; Enter activates it.
